acceptance_predicates.description: Plan creation refuses missing --config or --output and never selects a default plan filename.
A valid setup file compiles all selected agents, providers/models, workloads, monitors, measures, and sweep limits into one immutable plan.
The plan carries config identity/digest and required registry/tool/workload evidence for later validation.
Plan creation has no ProviderSelection or provider-selection-path input.

definition_of_done: The canonical setup-to-plan command creates a deterministic explicit-output benchmark plan.

inputs.description: AR-1828 removal of competing selection inputs.

gates.description: Focused CLI and property tests prove mandatory paths, deterministic binding, and atomic output.
